div.div: Instead of asking for a whole ENI, it tells the CNI to maintain a specific number of individual free IP addresses.

div.div: If you have 5 Pods running and WARM_IP_TARGET is set to 5, the CNI will ensure you have 10 IPs allocated. If you start a 6th Pod, the CNI will immediately request 1 more IP from AWS to maintain that "buffer" of 5.
